units.source_text: 金花偶尔放下手中的筷子，

en.t: Jinhua occasionally set down the chopsticks in her hand,
and looked around at her surroundings,

units.source_text: 宽敞的屋子里，除了雕龙玉柱和大朵的菊花盆栽，屋里寂静如水。

en.t: In the spacious room, apart from jade pillars carved with dragons and large potted chrysanthemums, everything was as still as water.
